value.headline: Iced Matcha Latte surges 158% in 13 weeks as matcha cements a cafe-core role

industry_trend.claim: Roughly 40% of matcha drinkers now report replacing at least one daily cup of coffee with matcha.

nudges.rationale: The Iced Matcha Latte is a fast-growing driver, yielding £29,546 in revenue over 13 weeks and now averaging around 671 units per week at week 13. Keeping stock prevents loss of roughly £2,273 in weekly revenue from stockouts.
nudges.title: Secure Iced Matcha Latte supply to protect revenue

nudges.rationale: Matcha attach rate is 8.2% today on 5,458 matcha transactions, with a weekly revenue opportunity of £207. Increasing bundle offers could lift weekly revenue beyond this baseline.
nudges.title: Boost matcha drink attach rate with bundled treats

value.sell_summary: Over the 13-week window, revenue totaled £157,469 from 26,023 transactions, with Filter Coffee remaining the top seller (£44,612) while matcha drinks contributed £57,138 (36.3% of revenue). Iced Matcha Latte grew from 260 to 671 units per week, driving £29,546 in revenue. Daily revenue is about £1,730, and the Miso Banana Loaf is fading (week 13: 59 units). There is a clear opportunity to boost margins by expanding matcha-treat pairings at point of sale.
